cron_flavor: Strict POSIX portability vs Vixie cron and OpenBSD
defect_category: Vixie cron and OpenBSD accept 0 or 7 as Sunday. Strict POSIX and GitHub Actions document numeric weekdays 0-6.
expected_behavior: Sunday 2026-11-29 04:00 EST (UTC-05:00) is 09:00 UTC. Evaluating the same expression in UTC gives 04:00 UTC.

schedule_intent: Run at 09:00 UTC only when the 1st or 15th of the month falls on a Monday
defect_category: With an unrestricted month, both dialects match a union of Mondays and dates 1 and 15.
expected_behavior: The union runs May 1, 8, 15, 22, and 29, 2028. The guarded job runs May 1 and 15 at 09:00 UTC, once per date.

schedule_intent: Run daily every 15 minutes from 09:00 through 17:45 UTC
cron_flavor: Vixie-style user crontab with a strict POSIX alternative
defect_category: The original steps through hours 00 and 15 on days 9-17. Strict POSIX excludes slash steps.
expected_behavior: The 9-17 hour range includes 17:00, 17:15, 17:30, and 17:45. The next run is 09:00 UTC the following day.

schedule_intent: Run at 00:00 UTC at the start of the month's last calendar day
defect_category: L is invalid in five-field Unix crontab. Quartz and EventBridge support L in day of month with ? in day of week.
corrected_schedule: 0 0 28-31 * * /usr/bin/env python3 -c 'from datetime import date, timedelta; raise SystemExit((date.today() + timedelta(days=1)).day != 1)' && /path/to/job
expected_behavior: At 00:00 UTC, the guard invokes the job only if tomorrow is day 1. The first run is November 30, 2026.

cron_flavor: Quartz vs EventBridge scheduled rules vs Unix crontab vs GitHub Actions
defect_category: Quartz and EventBridge require ? in one day field. A Vixie user crontab reads token 6 as command text and a system crontab reads it as username. GitHub Actions expects 5 fields.
expected_behavior: Corrected Quartz schedules every 10 seconds. EventBridge has minute precision and GitHub Actions has a five-minute minimum. The Vixie time fields alone match every ten minutes.
